mentions.name: Doppelkopf.club
mentions.description: This web app helps people learn and practice Doppelkopf, a traditional German card game, with an interactive tutorial and a browser-based singleplayer game. An English version has just been released.
mentions.problem: Doppelkopf is quite complex, which makes it super fun but also hard to pick up.
mentions.audience: People who want to learn and practice Doppelkopf
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a small web app with an interactive tutorial and a browser-based singleplayer game that helps people learn and practice Doppelkopf. I've just released an English version:

https://doppelkopf.club/en
